image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of an open white ring binder with red interior pockets. The binder contains loose-leaf papers with sketches and text. The left side shows a clear plastic pocket holding a document, while the right side shows a red pocket with a cutout design. The metal ring mechanism is partially visible at the top center.
